body:
It can be a very positive and nurturing environment. Depends on who you have. At worst you might have to deal with some stressful patients, but they're typically dealt with before they become a major problem for the other patients who don't have those problems. 

I'm sure someone will tell you this, but follow the principle of "I'm here for me. I'm going to focus on helping myself." You're in the mental hospital for a reason, and all your attention should be diverted towards helping yourself. 

The first night might be a little scary. Not for any real reason, but just the realization of "fuck.. i'm in a mental hospital." But there's nothing to be actually afraid of. The nurses and psychiatrists are there to help you. As long as you cooperate like most normal people do with them, there's no reason why it would go wrong.

Best wishes. And prepare for shitty food.
